candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, and the elect in the light of eternal life: the days of their life shall be unending, and the days of the holy without number' — eternal-light eschatology. Tewahedo eucharistic liturgy invokes this verse imagery in the post-communion prayer 'may we be among those whose days are unending' — direct textual borrowing from the Parables preserved in the Tewahedo liturgical memory.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition), Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71). Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.
